dedupe_keys.name: system net network of permanent gnss reference stations ukraine

description: System.NET is a commercial network of continuously operating GNSS reference stations in Ukraine run by the company System Solutions. Its RTK positioning page says the network gives centimetre accuracy in real time almost anywhere in Ukraine, with the advantages of network RTK over single base stations, and that corrections are sent as standardised messages to any GNSS receiver that can take RTK corrections over the internet through GSM or GPRS. The site also offers RINEX data downloads, a data processing service, coordinate recalculation, a coverage map of the RTK network, set-up guides for many receiver brands and the local MSK coordinate systems, precise guidance signals for farm machinery, and rental of a Leica GS08plus receiver with free connection. Users register and subscribe to one of the RTK packages through a service management system; the conditions are in the ordering section. Access is paid by subscription; no open licence is stated. Caveats: this is a private service, prices and the station list are not on the page read, and the site is in Ukrainian. Coverage is Ukraine. It supports studies of positioning infrastructure resilience in wartime conditions and of space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ASG-EUPOS of Poland and MOLDPOS of Moldova.
